reason: I'm a solo freelancer with one AI editor already paid for — I don't hop between three agents, so a shared context layer solves nothing for me, and I won't pay $30/month to lock my sessions and credentials into another daemon that could shut down and take them with it.
objection: If Loom goes away or I stop paying, my context is locked inside loomd with no exit — just another proprietary silo stacked on top of the one I already use.
would_change_my_mind: Plain-file export of everything (sessions, skills, MCP config, credentials) so my context is mine and usable without the daemon — or a genuinely free solo tier.
